items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest injury question on slate per Levitan; listed QUESTIONABLE, practiced Friday. Affects Herbert projections heavily; game 4pm ET. ETR Q list.
items.why: Ribs; practiced but status uncertain; biggest slate impact.
items.implication: If limited/out, LAC WR hierarchy and Herbert volume shift.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston or others see expanded routes/targets if McConkey sits or limited.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN per ETR Sunday injury list and Schefter/Rapoport corroboration. Missed practices after Wednesday injury; Grade 1 strain reported.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri; official OUT.
items.implication: Vacates ~25%+ target share; HOU WR room thins significantly.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers, especially TE.

items.text: Zay Flowers listed DOUBTFUL (hamstring) for Sunday vs NO; second straight DNP. Ja'Kobi Lane also out/IR-return. ETR groups as OUT OR DOUBTFUL.
items.implication: BAL WRs down to crumbs; hierarchy shifts to Bateman etc.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for remaining BAL WRs/TEs like Mark Andrews.

items.text: Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL (knee) for Sunday vs LAC per HC Klint Kubiak and Schefter; ETR lists OUT OR DOUBTFUL. McConkey practiced and Q opposite.
items.implication: LV TE production limited; pass game impacted.
items.opportunity: Potential uptick for Michael Mayer or other LV pass-catchers if OUT.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN and ready for 2026 debut; Levitan questions if Pats give 10+ touches vs Stevenson with AJ Brown IR and desperate need for playmakers. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go; AJ Brown IR creates playmaker void; matchups favorable.
items.implication: Potential committee or lead role expansion; 10+ touch upside.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, explosive plays in NE backfield; monitor vs Stevenson split.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey getting bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status matters for SF RB hierarchy.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black Q/groin impacts backup role.
items.implication: CMC volume secure/elevated; Black status secondary.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target share in favorable spots.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; Bengals list him Q for vs HOU. ETR notes said he's playing.
items.why: Back injury; player stated he will play; coach positive.
items.implication: CIN offense likely full strength at QB; Chase/Higgins intact.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% route targets tying team lead in W1 with Chiefs; Indy just gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. Massive season potential.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization (24% tgt share career-highish); soft IND run D.
items.implication: RB1 upside weekly; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: High snap, carry, target, RZ share vs vulnerable IND.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 Utilization Score W1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches 3/4 last. Kubiak offense; overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Elite util/volume in first Kubiak game; consistent prior workload.
items.opportunity: Touches, targets, RZ in featured role.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz. CHI D soft vs WRs recently.
items.why: High volume with Wentz; historical success; matchup.
items.opportunity: Target share, aDOT volume with Wentz under center.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8 in W1; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. Strong util.
items.why: Expanded receiving/RZ role vs Gainwell; soft CLE front.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, RZ carries dominant in TB backfield.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1; TEN allowed high catch/YPR rates. Back in after tough W1.
items.why: Strong aDOT/usage; favorable TEN secondary matchup.
items.opportunity: Deep targets, overall volume in PHI offense.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE: Home avg 21.3 PPG last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1; DAL high implied total (27) in high-total game.
items.why: Smash spot vs weak WAS pass D; home/implied total edge.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, most points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO underdog script vs BAL bad for rush.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return; poor script/matchup.
items.conflict: Kamara IN per ETR may reverse prior Etienne bump.
